subject: math
description: Derive and apply 30-60-90 triangle side relationships to find missing sides and angles.
learningObjectives: Derive the 30-60-90 side ratio from an equilateral triangle split by an altitude
Match the short leg, long leg, and hypotenuse to the 30 degree, 60 degree, and 90 degree angles
Use the ratio x : x\sqrt{3} : 2x to find missing side lengths
Find missing sides when the short leg, long leg, or hypotenuse is given
Identify and avoid common correspondence errors in special right triangles
Find missing angles in 30-60-90 triangle problems
prerequisites: Recognize right triangles and complementary acute angles
Use square roots in exact form
Identify opposite sides in a triangle
